meta.title: {appName} — Family tree in Bangla & English
meta.description: Build your family tree in Bangla or English. No sign-up needed.

landing.tagline: Your family's story, in one place
landing.description: Start with the oldest ancestor you remember and add the family around them, in Bangla or English.
landing.comingSoon: Family trees arrive in the next update. You can already create your account.

guest.title: You're using {appName} as a guest
guest.body: Everything you add is saved, but only in this browser. Create a free account to keep it safe and use it on other devices.
guest.retention: Guest data that isn't used for a year may be deleted.
guest.haveAccount: Already have an account? Log in

auth.signUpSubtitle: Everything you've added so far stays with you.

auth.signedUp: Your account is ready. Your work is now safe.

inAppBrowser.title: Open in your browser to use Google
inAppBrowser.body: Google sign-in doesn't work inside this app's built-in browser. Copy the link and open it in Chrome or Safari, or continue with your email below.
